scope: Welcome, returning explorer choice and existing Switch Explorer setup; no agent or other page behavior changes
diagnosis_before_changes: Active explorer correctly resumed Home; explicit switching used the separate profiles view.
Unselected Home always showed setup even with browser-remembered explorers.
First-time form lacked avatars and fictional acknowledgement. Switch form defaulted to Grade 11.
No durable request identity prevented duplicate explorer creation after a lost response.

entry_behavior.fresh: Welcome and shared setup; brand-only header
entry_behavior.remembered_without_active: Continue My Adventure / Create a New Explorer; no automatic selection
entry_behavior.valid_active: Existing Adventure Home and persisted progress
entry_behavior.explicit_switch: Existing profiles route with shared blank setup and browser-associated saved list

association: Existing browser-local cq_pid/cq_explorers IDs; each remembered ID validated through existing backend GET. No server-wide profile-list endpoint or first-global-profile selection. This is not authentication.

creation_contract.retry: React persists a UUID creation_key in sessionStorage until a validated success. SQLite serializes keyed creation and receipt together. Matching retries return the same profile; changed payload with same key returns 409. Avatar and association remain browser-local.
creation_contract.rewards: Zero XP, no quest completion, no profile confirmation from creation.

automated.backend_restart: passed; /api/health reports langgraph; existing confirmed fictional explorer read successfully

browser.data: Separate /private/tmp SQLite database and isolated .localhost origins; normal demo profiles were never selected or edited by these UI tests.
passed: Fresh origin shows setup despite unrelated existing server profiles; no global record is selected or listed.
No student identity, grade, XP or main student navigation before selection.
Empty/whitespace nickname, missing grade and unchecked acknowledgement each disable creation.
Keyboard arrow selection changes avatar and shows visible focus; Enter creates an explorer.
Successful creation shows Welcome aboard and one First Mission action; it opens actual Quest 1.
Double-click creation produces one profile and one receipt.
One quest saved: reload restores 20 XP, saved answer and Continue Quest 2.
Explicit Switch Explorer retains the active explorer and opens blank nickname, no grade, unchecked acknowledgement.
Returning with no active selection offers Continue and New; saved list includes only that origin’s associated explorers.
Create a New Explorer opens setup separately from saved list.
Simulated lost response after a successful save preserves entered values. Reload and resubmit with persisted key recover one matching explorer, zero XP, unconfirmed profile.
Switching back and reloading retains the earlier explorer’s answer, 20 XP and Quest 2 resume.
Measured widths 375, 768 and 1280 CSS pixels have matching document widths; mobile setup stacks and accepts a 40-character nickname without overflow.
Final returning-origin console error readback empty.
browser.simulation_details: Temporary verification middleware returns 404 for a chosen isolated fixture ID to exercise expired active association, then is disabled. No records are deleted. Another temporary middleware returns one 503 after a successful POST to simulate loss of response; the subsequent normal retry recovers the same receipt. No such middleware was added to application source.

test_fixture_note: Existing Python API test and smoke fixtures only add fictional_ack:true. Their prior behavioral assertions are unchanged. Two existing frontend presentation assertions were updated for the requested first-time form and minimal header; new assertions cover entry states and separation.
intermediate_failures: Initial npm run build was issued from repository root and failed ENOENT; corrected to frontend directory. A few repository-relative read/style-append commands were issued from frontend and failed; corrected before final build.
First frontend run had two old presentation expectation failures for the now-replaced first-time form/header; updated to the requested requirements.

A new test initially assumed GET /api/profiles would return 405. The existing static mount returns 404; corrected that new assertion to the actual no-list behavior. All original test expectations retained except the explicitly changed frontend presentation.
A float viewport override was rejected by the browser tool; final measurements use supported integer overrides and actual DOM widths.
unverified: No full VoiceOver or other assistive-technology audit; native accessibility tree and keyboard controls were checked.
OS reduced-motion preference was not toggled; reduced-motion CSS retained and setup overrides inspected.
No real iOS/Android device or separate private-browser profile was used; fresh per-origin storage and desktop Chrome responsive viewports were used.
No live Groq inference or new career/portfolio flow walkthrough in this onboarding-only scope; existing backend/frontend regression suites cover those features.
A reload after a failed creation response requires re-entering the same setup; the pending retry key survives and prevents duplicate creation.
The three optional discovery smoke scripts received only the required fictional-ack fixture update and compiled successfully; they were not separately executed.
cleanup: Isolated browser tabs closed, temporary viewport overrides cleared and isolated verification server stopped. Normal backend remains running on port 8000; original selected demo explorer unchanged.
